name: a Navi's AI data's pool bit, BN6's
why: BN6's AI data comes from a pool of eight, each entry's own bit at +0x7C (bn6_ai.h BN6_AI_POOL_BIT: entry i bit 31 - i, laid out by the take 0x0800ED2C; GutsMan's entry 1, 0x40000000, +0x7F 0x40), which its let-go clears (0x0800ED80). BN4 has no pool, one AI data a side (BN4_AI_DATA): BN6's own
